var moved = false; el.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { if (e.button !== undefined && e.button !== 0) return; start = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, left: state.pos.x, bottom: state.pos.y }; moved = false; if (el.setPointerCapture) { try { el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {} } }); el.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { if (!start) return; var dx = e.clientX - start.x; var dy = e.clientY - start.y; if (!moved && Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) < 6) return; moved = true; state.pos.x = start.left + dx; state.pos.y = start.bottom - dy; clampPos(); applyPos(); }); el.addEventListener('pointerup', function () { if (!start) return; var wasMoved = moved; start = null; if (wasMoved) { store(CONFIG.storage.pos, JSON.stringify(state.pos)); } else { randomReact(); } }); el.addEventListener('pointercancel', function () { start = null; }); el.addEventListener('dblclick', function () { state.pos.x = CONFIG.left; state.pos.y = CONFIG.bottom; applyPos(); store(CONFIG.storage.pos, JSON.stringify(state.pos)); }); } function renderLive2d(item) { var PIXI = window.PIXI; var live2d = PIXI && PIXI.live2d; if (!live2d || !live2d.Live2DModel) { return Promise.reject( new Error('pixi-live2d-display / Cubism Core 未加载，检查 inject.bottom 的脚本顺序') ); } var app = new PIXI.Application({ transparent: true, antialias: true, autoDensity: true, resolution: Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2), width: 1, height: CONFIG.height }); app.view.setAttribute('role', 'img'); app.view.setAttribute('aria-label', item.name); state.app = app; state.stage.insertBefore(app.view, state.btn); return live2d.Live2DModel.from(item.path, { autoInteract: !REDUCE, idleMotionGroup: 'idle' }).then(function (model) { app.stage.addChild(model); state.model = model; // 用未缩放的局部包围盒算缩放，避免不同版本 width/height 语义差异 var box = model.getLocalBounds(); var srcH = box.height || 1; var s = (CONFIG.height / srcH) * (item.scale || 1); model.scale.set(s); model.x = -box.x * s + 6; model.y = CONFIG.height - (box.y + box.height) * s; app.renderer.resize(Math.max(1, Math.ceil(box.width * s + 12)), CONFIG.height); playMotion(model, 'idle'); enableDrag(app.view); var settings = state.settingsById[item.id]; var extras = (settings && settings.motions) || []; if (!REDUCE && CONFIG.extraMotionInterval > 0 && extras.length) { state.ticker = setInterval(function () { playMotion(model, extras[Math.floor(Math.random() * extras.length)]); }, CONFIG.extraMotionInterval); } }); } /* ---- 视频类角色自适应：量出人物在画面里的包围盒，再缩放到看板娘框内 ---- */ // 把「可见包围盒」映射到目标框：纯函数，便于离线验证 function computeFit(bbox, videoW, videoH, targetH, pad) { if (!bbox || !(bbox.width > 0) || !(bbox.height > 0)) return null; if (!(videoW > 0) || !(videoH > 0)) return null; var scale = (targetH - pad * 2) / bbox.height; return { scale: scale, boxW: Math.round(bbox.width * scale + pad * 2), boxH: targetH, // 视频元素自身的尺寸 videoW: Math.round(videoW * scale), videoH: Math.round(videoH * scale), // 让包围盒左下角落在 (pad, targetH - pad) left: Math.round(pad - bbox.x * scale), top: Math.round(targetH - pad - (bbox.y + bbox.height) * scale) }; } function unionBox(a, b) { if (!a) return b; if (!b) return a; var minX = Math.min(a.x, b.x); var minY = Math.min(a.y, b.y); var maxX = Math.max(a.x + a.width, b.x + b.width); var maxY = Math.max(a.y + a.height, b.y + b.height); return { x: minX, y: minY, width: maxX - minX, height: maxY - minY }; } // 扫描一帧的非透明像素范围（隔 2 像素采样，够用且快） function scanAlpha(ctx, w, h) { var data; try { data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data; } catch (e) { return null; } var minX = w; var minY = h; var maxX = -1; var maxY = -1; for (var y = 0; y < h; y += 2) { for (var x = 0; x < w; x += 2) { if (data[(y * w + x) * 4 + 3] > 8) { if (x < minX) minX = x; if (x > maxX) maxX = x; if (y < minY) minY = y; if (y > maxY) maxY = y; } } } if (maxX < 0) return null; return { x: minX, y: minY, width: maxX - minX + 1, height: maxY - minY + 1 }; } // 抽几帧取并集，兼顾动作（挥手/走动）时的最大范围 function measureAlphaBBox(video) { return new Promise(function (resolve) { var vw = video.videoWidth; var vh = video.videoHeight; if (!vw || !vh) return resolve(null); var canvas = document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width = vw; canvas.height = vh; var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); if (!ctx) return resolve(null); var dur = isFinite(video.duration) ? video.duration : 0; var times = [0.15, 0.6, 1.2]; var box = null; var i = 0; var done = false; var timer = setTimeout(finish, 2500); function finish() { if (done) return; done = true; clearTimeout(timer); resolve(box); } function next() { if (done) return; if (i >= times.length) return finish(); var t = times[i]; i += 1; if (dur && t > dur - 0.05) return next(); var onSeeked = function () { video.removeEventListener('seeked', onSeeked); try { ctx.clearRect(0, 0, vw, vh); ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, vw, vh); box = unionBox(box, scanAlpha(ctx, vw, vh)); } catch (e) {} next(); }; video.addEventListener('seeked', onSeeked); try { video.currentTime = t; } catch (e) { video.removeEventListener('seeked', onSeeked); next(); } } next(); }); } function renderVideo(item) { var h = CONFIG.height; var pad = 6; // 量测完成前的临时尺寸，量完会按人物实际大小改掉 var fallbackW = Math.max(1, Math.round(h * (item.videoAspect || 0.62))); var wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.className = 'l2d-video'; wrap.style.height = h + 'px'; wrap.style.width = fallbackW + 'px'; var video = document.createElement('video'); video.muted = true; video.defaultMuted = true; video.loop = true; video.autoplay = true; video.playsInline = true; video.setAttribute('muted', ''); video.setAttribute('playsinline', ''); video.setAttribute('aria-label', item.name); video.src = item.path; video.style.height = h + 'px'; video.style.opacity = '0'; // 量好尺寸再显示，避免闪一下小图 wrap.appendChild(video); state.video = video; state.stage.insertBefore(wrap, state.btn); enableDrag(wrap); function applyFit(fit) { if (!state.root || !wrap.isConnected) return; if (fit) { wrap.style.width = fit.boxW + 'px'; wrap.style.height = fit.boxH + 'px'; video.style.width = fit.videoW + 'px'; video.style.height = fit.videoH + 'px'; video.style.left = fit.left + 'px'; video.style.top = fit.top + 'px'; video.style.transform = 'none'; } video.style.opacity = '1'; } function start() { var p = video.play(); if (p && typeof p.catch === 'function') p.catch(function () {}); } var measured = false; function onReady() { if (measured) return; measured = true; var vw = video.videoWidth; var vh = video.videoHeight; // 先暂停再抽帧测量，避免边播边 seek 的不确定性 try { video.pause(); } catch (e) {} measureAlphaBBox(video) .then(function (box) { applyFit(computeFit(box, vw, vh, h, pad)); try { video.currentTime = 0; } catch (e) {} start(); }) .catch(function () { applyFit(null); start(); }); } video.addEventListener('loadeddata', onReady, { once: true }); video.addEventListener('error', function () { onReady(); }); // 兜底：3 秒还没量出来就直接按临时尺寸显示，避免一直隐身 setTimeout(function () { if (!measured) { measured = true; applyFit(null); start(); } }, 3000); return Promise.resolve(); } /* ---- 静态立绘角色：按 300px 高显示，可选 Q 版 ---- */ function variantKey(item) { if (!item || !item.variants || !item.variants.q) return 'normal'; return state.variants[item.id] === 'q' ? 'q' : 'normal'; } function variantSource(item, key) { if (key === 'q' && item.variants && item.variants.q) return item.variants.q; return null; } function syncVariantButton(item, key) { if (!state.variantBtn) return; var qActive = key === 'q'; state.variantBtn.textContent = qActive ? '原版' : 'Q版'; state.variantBtn.title = qActive ? '切换到原版立绘' : '切换到 Q 版立绘'; state.variantBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', state.variantBtn.title); state.variantBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', qActive ? 'true' : 'false'); } function applyVariant(item, key) { var source = variantSource(item, key); if (state.image) { state.image.src = source ? source.path : item.path; state.image.alt = item.name + (source ? ' · ' + source.label : ''); } syncVariantButton(item, key); } function toggleVariant(item) { if (!item || !item.variants || !item.variants.q) return; var next = variantKey(item) === 'q' ? 'normal' : 'q'; state.variants[item.id] = next; store(CONFIG.storage.variant, JSON.stringify(state.variants)); applyVariant(item, next); if (state.menu && state.menu.classList.contains('is-open')) buildMenu(); } function renderSprite(item) { var canvas = document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.className = 'l2d-sprite-canvas'; canvas.width = 384; canvas.height = 416; canvas.setAttribute('role', 'img'); canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', item.name + ' Q 版动态桌宠'); var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); if (!ctx) return Promise.reject(new Error('无法创建精灵图 Canvas')); ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true; var epoch = state.spriteEpoch + 1; state.spriteEpoch = epoch; state.spriteCanvas = canvas; state.spriteCtx = ctx; state.spriteImage = null; state.stage.insertBefore(canvas, state.btn); enableDrag(canvas); return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) { var img = new Image(); img.decoding = 'async'; img.onload = function () { if (epoch !== state.spriteEpoch) return; state.spriteImage = img; drawSpriteFrame(SPRITE_ROWS.idle.row, 0); if (!state.spritePaused && !REDUCE) playSpriteRow('idle', true); resolve(); }; img.onerror = function () { reject(new Error('动态桌宠图集加载失败：' + item.path)); }; img.src = item.path; }); } function renderImage(item) { var key = variantKey(item); var source = variantSource(item, key); var figure = document.createElement('div'); figure.className = 'l2d-art'; var tilt = document.createElement('div'); tilt.className = 'l2d-art-tilt'; var img = document.createElement('img'); img.alt = item.name + (source ? ' · ' + source.label : ''); img.decoding = 'async'; img.draggable = false; tilt.appendChild(img); state.art = figure; state.artTilt = tilt; state.image = img; figure.classList.toggle('is-motion-paused', state.imagePaused); if (item.variants && item.variants.q) { var toggle = document.createElement('button'); toggle.type = 'button'; toggle.className = 'l2d-variant'; state.variantBtn = toggle; syncVariantButton(item, key); toggle.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); }); toggle.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); toggleVariant(item); }); figure.appendChild(toggle); } figure.insertBefore(tilt, figure.firstChild); state.stage.insertBefore(figure, state.btn); enableDrag(figure); enableArtParallax(figure, tilt); return new Promise(function (resolve) { var settled = false; function done() { if (settled) return; settled = true; img.classList.add('is-loaded'); resolve(); } img.addEventListener('load', done, { once: true }); img.addEventListener('error', done, { once: true }); img.src = source ? source.path : item.path; if (img.complete) done(); }); } function enableArtParallax(figure, tilt) { if (REDUCE || !tilt) return; var frame = 0; var pending = null; function apply() { frame = 0; if (!pending || !tilt.isConnected) return; tilt.style.setProperty('--l2d-tilt-x', pending.x.toFixed(2) + 'deg'); tilt.style.setProperty('--l2d-tilt-y', pending.y.toFixed(2) + 'deg'); } figure.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { if (state.imagePaused) return; var rect = figure.getBoundingClientRect(); if (!(rect.width > 0) || !(rect.height > 0)) return; var x = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width - 0.5; var y = (e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height - 0.5; pending = { x: -y * 4.5, y: x * 5.5 }; if (!frame) frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(apply); }); function reset() { pending = { x: 0, y: 0 }; if (!frame) frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(apply); } figure.addEventListener('pointerleave', reset); figure.addEventListener('pointercancel', reset); } function render(item) { teardown(); state.current = item; if (state.root) state.root.classList.remove('is-hidden'); return loadSettings(item) .then(function () { if (item.type === 'sprite') return renderSprite(item); if (item.type === 'image') return renderImage(item); return item.type === 'video' ? renderVideo(item) : renderLive2d(item); }) .then(function () { showGreeting(); }) .catch(function (err) { warn('渲染「' + item.name + '」失败：' + item.path, err); teardown(); if (state.root) state.root.classList.add('is-hidden'); }); } function switchTo(item) { store(CONFIG.storage.model, item.id); return render(item).then(buildMenu); } /* ---------------- 收起 / 展开 ---------------- */ function setCollapsed(v) { state.collapsed = !!v; store(CONFIG.storage.collapsed, state.collapsed ? '1' : '0'); if (state.root) state.root.classList.toggle('is-collapsed', state.collapsed); if (state.collapsed) hideBubble(); else if (state.current) showGreeting(); if (state.btn) { state.btn.textContent = state.collapsed ? '🐟' : '☺'; state.btn.title = state.collapsed ? '展开看板娘' : '看板娘菜单'; } } /* ---------------- 生命周期 ---------------- */ function isMobile() { try { return window.matchMedia('(max-width: ' + CONFIG.mobileMaxWidth + 'px)').matches; } catch (e) { return false; } } function restorePrefs() { // 位置：优先用记住的 try { var saved = JSON.parse(read(CONFIG.storage.pos) || 'null'); if (saved && typeof saved.x === 'number' && typeof saved.y === 'number') { state.pos = { x: saved.x, y: saved.y }; } } catch (e) {} try { var savedVariants = JSON.parse(read(CONFIG.storage.variant) || '{}'); if (savedVariants && typeof savedVariants === 'object') { state.variants = savedVariants; } } catch (e) {} state.imagePaused = read(CONFIG.storage.imagePaused) === '1'; state.spritePaused = read(CONFIG.storage.spritePaused) === '1'; } // 首屏只探测「要显示的那个角色」，其余角色的可用性交给后台补探测： // 11 个 HEAD 全部等完再渲染，等于把看板娘的出现推迟了一个最慢请求的时延。 function boot() { if (state.root) return; if (isMobile()) return; restorePrefs(); var savedModel = read(CONFIG.storage.model); var candidates = MODELS.filter(function (m) { return m.id === savedModel; }).concat( MODELS.filter(function (m) { return m.id !== savedModel; }) ); // available: null 表示还没探测到，菜单里显示「检测中」 state.entries = MODELS.map(function (item) { return { item: item, available: null }; }); var started = false; function attempt(index) { if (started || index >= candidates.length) { if (!started) { warn( '没有任何可用模型素材，看板娘不渲染。可放置位置：' + MODELS.map(function (m) { return m.path; }).join(' / ') ); } return; } probe(candidates[index].path).then(function (ok) { if (!ok) return attempt(index + 1); if (started || state.root) return; started = true; startWith(candidates[index]); }); } attempt(0); // 其余角色的可用性只在第一次打开角色菜单时探测： // 不开菜单的访客，页面只拉当前角色的素材，一个多余的请求都不发。 var probing = false; probeRestDeferred = function () { if (probing) return; probing = true; probeRestDeferred = null; resolveModels().then(function (entries) { state.entries = entries; if (!started) return; // 菜单开着就把「检测中 / 不可用」更新掉 if (state.menu && state.menu.classList.contains('is-open')) buildMenu(); }); }; } function startWith(item) { buildShell(); clampPos(); applyPos(); // 有素材就把按钮露出来（只有一个角色也给，否则用户找不到入口） state.btn.classList.add('is-visible'); if (read(CONFIG.storage.collapsed) === '1') setCollapsed(true); render(item).then(buildMenu); } function ensureMounted() { if (state.root && document.body.contains(state.root)) return; state.root = null; boot(); } function onReady(fn) { if (document.readyState === 'loading') { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn, { once: true }); } else { fn(); } } // 给离线验证用：暴露纯函数，不参与运行时逻辑 window.__l2dMascotInternals = { computeFit: computeFit, unionBox: unionBox, scanAlpha: scanAlpha }; onReady(boot); document.addEventListener('pjax:complete', ensureMounted); window.addEventListener('resize', function () { clampPos(); applyPos(); });})();

entry.title: 音乐馆
entry.content:
Playlist

音乐馆

写代码、整理笔记、发呆和赶路时的背景声。这里放一张完整歌单，慢慢听就好。

听歌状态 循环播放
歌单来源 网易云歌单 8152976493
适合场景 学习、写博客、整理思路

/* * Vanilla WebGL2 adapter for React Bits LiquidEther. * Upstream: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits * Shader sources: shaders.js (vendored, see REACT_BITS_LICENSE.txt). */import { VERTEX, SPLAT, SMOOTH, DIVERGENCE, PRESSURE, PROJECT, ADVECT, DISPLAY} from './shaders.js';const PIXEL_BUDGET = 2.4e6;const MAX_CELLS = 140000;const PRESSURE_STEPS = 32;const PALETTE_SIZE = 256;const clamp = (value, min, max) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));const keepFor = (persistence, dt) => Math.pow(0.5, dt / (0.35 + persistence * persistence * 12));function parseColor(value) { const text = String(value || '').trim(); const hex = /^#?([0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(text); if (hex) { const full = hex[1].length === 3 ? hex[1].replace(/./g, (digit) => digit + digit) : hex[1]; return [0, 2, 4].map((index) => parseInt(full.slice(index, index + 2), 16) / 255); } const rgb = /^rgba?\(\s*([\d.]+)[\s,]+([\d.]+)[\s,]+([\d.]+)/i.exec(text); if (rgb) return [rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3]].map((channel) => clamp(parseFloat(channel) / 255, 0, 1)); return null;}const toLinear = (channel) => (channel <= 0.04045 ? channel / 12.92 : Math.pow((channel + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4));function buildPalette(colors) { const stops = []; colors.forEach((color) => { const parsed = parseColor(color); if (parsed) stops.push(parsed); }); if (!stops.length) stops.push([1, 1, 1]); const values = stops.map((color) => color.map(toLinear)); const data = new Uint8Array(PALETTE_SIZE * 4); for (let index = 0; index < PALETTE_SIZE; index += 1) { const t = clamp((index / (PALETTE_SIZE - 1)) * values.length - 0.5, 0, values.length - 1); const from = Math.min(Math.floor(t), Math.max(values.length - 2, 0)); const to = Math.min(from + 1, values.length - 1); const k = t - from; const eased = k * k * (3 - 2 * k); for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel += 1) { const value = values[from][channel] + (values[to][channel] - values[from][channel]) * eased; data[index * 4 + channel] = Math.round(clamp(value, 0, 1) * 255); } data[index * 4 + 3] = 255; } return data;}function compile(gl, type, source) { const shader = gl.createShader(type); if (!shader) return null; gl.shaderSource(shader, source); gl.compileShader(shader); if (gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) return shader; console.warn('[liquid-ether] shader error:', gl.getShaderInfoLog(shader)); gl.deleteShader(shader); return null;}function link(gl, fragmentSource) { const vertex = compile(gl, gl.VERTEX_SHADER, VERTEX); const fragment = compile(gl, gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragmentSource); const program = vertex && fragment ? gl.createProgram() : null; if (!vertex || !fragment || !program) { if (vertex) gl.deleteShader(vertex); if (fragment) gl.deleteShader(fragment); return null; } gl.attachShader(program, vertex); gl.attachShader(program, fragment); gl.linkProgram(program); gl.deleteShader(vertex); gl.deleteShader(fragment); if (!gl.getProgramParameter(program, gl.LINK_STATUS)) { console.warn('[liquid-ether] link error:', gl.getProgramInfoLog(program)); gl.deleteProgram(program); return null; } const uniforms = {}; const count = gl.getProgramParameter(program, gl.ACTIVE_UNIFORMS); for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) { const info = gl.getActiveUniform(program, index); if (info) uniforms[info.name] = gl.getUniformLocation(program, info.name); } return { program, uniforms };}export function mountLiquidEther(container, userOptions = {}) { if (!container) return () => {}; const p = { colors: ['#5227FF', '#FF9FFC', '#B497CF'], intensity: 1, mouseForce: 20, cursorSize: 100, persistence: 0.75, viscosity: 0, resolution: 0.5, bounceEdges: false, clickBurst: true, autoDemo: true, autoSpeed: 0.5, autoIntensity: 2.2, autoResumeDelay: 3000, autoRampDuration: 0.6, intro: true, lightMode: false, backgroundColor: 'transparent', maxDevicePixelRatio: 2, interactive: false, isActive: null, ...userOptions }; const canvas = document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.className = 'liquid-ether__canvas'; canvas.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl2', { alpha: true, premultipliedAlpha: true, antialias: false, depth: false, stencil: false, powerPreference: 'high-performance' }); if (!gl || (!gl.getExtension('EXT_color_buffer_float') && !gl.getExtension('EXT_color_buffer_half_float'))) { container.dataset.motionFallback = 'liquid-ether'; return () => {}; } container.appendChild(canvas); const programs = { splat: link(gl, SPLAT), smooth: link(gl, SMOOTH), divergence: link(gl, DIVERGENCE), pressure: link(gl, PRESSURE), project: link(gl, PROJECT), advect: link(gl, ADVECT), display: link(gl, DISPLAY) }; entry.title: Recall API
entry.content: <!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Recall API</title></head><body><section class="recall-home"> <style>@property --rx { syntax: '<percentage>'; inherits: true; initial-value: 58%; } @property --ry { syntax: '<percentage>'; inherits: true; initial-value: 68%; } :root { color-scheme: dark; } html, body, #root, .app-layout { background: #050709 !important; } body { margin: 0 !important; } .app-layout { min-height: 100svh !important; } .app-layout > .semi-layout-header { display: none !important; } .app-layout > .semi-layout { height: 100svh !important; overflow-x: hidden !important; overflow-y: auto !important; scroll-behavior: smooth; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: rgba(255,255,255,.22) transparent; background: #050709 !important; } .app-layout > .semi-layout > .semi-layout > .semi-layout-footer { display: none !important; } .app-layout > .semi-layout::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 7px; } .app-layout > .semi-layout::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; } .app-layout > .semi-layout::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); border-radius: 99px; } .semi-layout-content { min-height:100svh!important; background:#050709!important; overflow:visible!important; } .semi-layout-content > div, .semi-layout-content div[class*="overflow-x-hidden"] { overflow:visible!important; } .recall-home { --rh-bg:#050709; --rh-text:#f7f8f8; --rh-muted:rgba(255,255,255,.56); --rh-line:rgba(255,255,255,.12); --rh-cyan:#08b8d8; --rh-green:#36c980; --rh-amber:#e9b832; --rh-red:#ff5757; position:relative; min-height:100svh; overflow-x:clip; background:var(--rh-bg); color:var(--rh-text); font-family:"Public Sans",Inter,"SF Pro Display","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; text-rendering:optimizeLegibility; } .recall-home *, .recall-home *::before, .recall-home *::after { box-sizing:border-box; } .recall-home a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none; } .recall-home button { font:inherit; } .recall-home img { max-width:none; } .recall-home ::selection { color:#fff; background:rgba(8,184,216,.48); } .rh-header { position:fixed; inset:0 0 auto; z-index:1000; height:62px; padding:0 clamp(18px,3vw,36px); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,4,6,.72),rgba(2,4,6,.18) 68%,transparent); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.055); backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(130%); } .rh-brand { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; min-width:148px; font-size:14px; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:-.01em; } .rh-logo-mark { width:25px; height:25px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:50%; color:#fff; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; background:radial-gradient(circle at 34% 25%,rgba(255,255,255,.48),transparent 32%),linear-gradient(145deg,#8b6cff,#6940c8 58%,#42237c); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.22),0 6px 20px rgba(108,67,215,.25); } .rh-nav { position:absolute; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:2px; } .rh-nav a { padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.66); font-size:13px; font-weight:540; transition:color .2s ease,background .2s ease; } .rh-nav a:hover { color:#fff; background:rgba(255,255,255,.065); } .rh-tools { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; } .rh-tool { width:34px; height:34px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:50%; color:rgba(255,255,255,.74); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09); background:rgba(255,255,255,.035); transition:.2s ease; } .rh-tool:hover { color:#fff; border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2); background:rgba(255,255,255,.09); } .rh-console { min-height:36px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:0 15px; border-radius:999px; background:#f5f5f3; color:#0a0b0c!important; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; transition:transform .2s ease,background .2s ease; } .rh-console:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); background:#fff; } .rh-avatar { width:31px; height:31px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:50%; color:#fff; font-size:11px; font-weight:750; background:linear-gradient(145deg,#8d6cff,#6c43cd); } .rh-mobile-console { display:none; } .rh-hero { position:sticky; top:0; z-index:0; min-height:100svh; overflow:hidden; isolation:isolate; background:#050708; } .rh-ocean { position:absolute; inset:0; overflow:hidden; } .rh-ocean > img { width:108%; height:108%; object-fit:cover; object-position:50% 54%; position:absolute; left:-4%; top:-4%; filter:grayscale(1) brightness(.54) contrast(1.12); transform-origin:52% 70%; animation:rh-ocean-breathe 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .rh-ripple-layer { --rx:58%; --ry:68%; position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:5; overflow:hidden; pointer-events:none; opacity:.9; mix-blend-mode:screen; mask-image:radial-gradient(circle 140px at var(--rx) var(--ry),#000 0 18%,rgba(0,0,0,.88) 38%,rgba(0,0,0,.35) 62%,transparent 100%); -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle 140px at var(--rx) var(--ry),#000 0 18%,rgba(0,0,0,.88) 38%,rgba(0,0,0,.35) 62%,transparent 100%); transition:--rx .16s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),--ry .16s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .22s ease; } .rh-ripple-layer video { position:absolute; width:100vw; height:100vh; left:var(--rx); top:var(--ry); transform:translate(-55%,-63%) scale(1.06); object-fit:cover; object-position:50% 54%; pointer-events:none; filter:brightness(.72) contrast(1.1); } .rh-pointer-grid { position:absolute; inset:30% 0 0; z-index:6; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(14,minmax(0,1fr)); grid-template-rows:repeat(9,minmax(0,1fr)); pointer-events:none; } .rh-hotspot { display:block; pointer-events:auto; } .rh-ocean:has(.rh-hotspot:hover) .rh-ripple-layer { opacity:.95; } .rh-wave-glint { position:absolute; left:-8%; right:-8%; bottom:-12%; z-index:4; height:72%; pointer-events:none; opacity:.36; mix-blend-mode:screen; filter:blur(.7px); background:repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 112%,transparent 0 15px,rgba(255,255,255,.1) 16px 18px,transparent 19px 36px); mask-image:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(0,0,0,.92),rgba(0,0,0,.7) 48%,transparent 100%); transform-origin:50% 100%; animation:rh-wave-sweep 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .rh-ocean::before { content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:1; pointer-events:none; background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 47%,transparent 0 22%,rgba(0,0,0,.12) 42%,rgba(0,0,0,.58) 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.38),transparent 38%,rgba(0,0,0,.24)); } .rh-ocean::after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:-18%; z-index:3; pointer-events:none; opacity:.38; mix-blend-mode:screen; background:repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 108%,transparent 0 16px,rgba(255,255,255,.09) 17px 18px,transparent 19px 34px); filter:blur(.45px); transform-origin:50% 100%; animation:rh-water-ripple 11s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .rh-noise { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:3; pointer-events:none; opacity:.18; mix-blend-mode:overlay; background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 180 180' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.85' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.75'/%3E%3C/svg%3E"); animation:rh-noise-shift .7s steps(2) infinite; } .rh-hero-shade { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:4; pointer-events:none; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.54) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.08) 27%,rgba(0,0,0,.16) 63%,rgba(3,5,7,.92) 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.28),transparent 55%); } .rh-hero-inner { position:relative; z-index:8; min-height:100svh; display:flex; flex-direction:column; pointer-events:none; } .rh-hero-main { flex:1; width:100%; max-width:1152px; margin:0 auto; padding:122px 24px 46px; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; } .rh-hero-copy { width:min(650px,100%); animation:rh-rise-in 1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } .rh-kicker { display:inline-block; margin-bottom:21px; font-size:12px; line-height:1; font-weight:720; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; background:linear-gradient(110deg,rgba(255,255,255,.52) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.52) 35%,#fff 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.52) 65%,rgba(255,255,255,.52) 100%); background-size:220% auto; -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; animation:rh-kicker-shimmer 5.4s linear infinite; } .rh-title { max-width:12ch; margin:0; font-size:clamp(48px,6vw,72px); line-height:1.03; letter-spacing:-.045em; font-weight:620; text-wrap:balance; } .rh-title span { display:block; color:rgba(255,255,255,.62); } .rh-hero-copy > p { max-width:620px; margin:25px 0 0; color:rgba(255,255,255,.7); font-size:clamp(14px,1.5vw,17px); line-height:1.82; } .rh-actions { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin-top:30px; pointer-events:auto; } .rh-btn { min-height:48px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; padding:0 20px; border-radius:999px; font-size:13px; font-weight:660; transition:transform .22s ease,border-color .22s ease,background .22s ease; } .rh-btn:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .rh-btn-primary { color:#0b0c0d!important; background:#fafaf8; box-shadow:0 12px 38px rgba(255,255,255,.14); } .rh-btn-primary:hover { background:#fff; } .rh-btn-outline { color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)!important; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.24); background:rgba(0,0,0,.19); backdrop-filter:blur(8px); } .rh-btn-outline:hover { border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.48); background:rgba(255,255,255,.095); } .rh-model-strip { position:relative; z-index:8; padding:15px 22px 19px; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06); background:rgba(0,0,0,.08); backdrop-filter:blur(8px); } .rh-model-strip-inner { width:min(1156px,100%); margin:0 auto; display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr); align-items:center; gap:34px; } .rh-model-label { color:rgba(255,255,255,.47); font-size:9px; font-weight:720; letter-spacing:.17em; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap; } .rh-marquee { min-width:0; overflow:hidden; mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 7%,#000 93%,transparent); } .rh-marquee-track { width:max-content; display:flex; align-items:center; animation:rh-marquee 28s linear infinite; } .rh-marquee-group { display:flex; align-items:center; } .rh-provider { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; margin-right:38px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.74); font-size:13px; font-weight:580; white-space:nowrap; } .rh-provider b { width:18px; height:18px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:6px; font-size:10px; font-weight:800; background:rgba(255,255,255,.07); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08); } .rh-provider b.cyan{color:#45dcff}.rh-provider b.green{color:#62e6a0}.rh-provider b.amber{color:#ffd45b}.rh-provider b.red{color:#ff7777}.rh-provider b.violet{color:#b393ff}.rh-provider b.blue{color:#6fabff} .rh-scroll-cue { position:absolute; z-index:9; right:26px; bottom:104px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.38); font-size:9px; font-weight:680; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; writing-mode:vertical-rl; } .rh-scroll-cue::after { content:""; width:1px; height:48px; background:linear-gradient(#fff,transparent); animation:rh-scroll-line 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; } .rh-sheet { position:relative; z-index:10; background:#080a0c; box-shadow:0 -30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.35); } .rh-anchor { scroll-margin-top:74px; } .rh-intro { position:relative; min-height:100svh; padding:70px 22px; overflow:hidden; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:#080a0c; } .rh-grid-bg { position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; background-image:linear-gradient(to right,rgba(255,255,255,.12) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(255,255,255,.12) 1px,transparent 1px); background-size:32px 32px; auto; color:rgba(255,255,255,.78); font-size:clamp(38px,7vw,88px); line-height:1.07; font-weight:620; letter-spacing:-.05em; text-shadow:0 2px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.55); } .rh-intro p { max-width:720px; margin:24px auto 0; color:var(--rh-muted); font-size:14px; line-height:1.9; } .rh-expand-wrap { position:relative; height:230svh; background:#080a0c; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07); entry.title: 关于 - Recall API
entry.content:
RRecall API
主页 控制台 模型广场 排行榜 关于
⌘ ◫ i 控制台 → R

ABOUT RECALL API · ONE ENDPOINT

关于 Recall 让连接更简单。

Recall API 是一个由 New API 驱动的模型聚合入口。用一套兼容 OpenAI 的接口连接不同供应商，在同一个控制台中管理令牌、余额与用量。

OpenAI兼容协议
统一模型入口
透明计费目录

BUILT FOR BUILDERS

少改代码，多接模型。

保留熟悉的 OpenAI 调用方式，把供应商差异留在网关之后。模型广场负责展示，控制台负责实际接入与管理。

⌘

统一接口

沿用 OpenAI 兼容协议与常见 SDK，通过同一个基础地址调用目录中的模型，减少为不同供应商重复适配的成本。

◫

透明目录

模型广场展示当前可用模型、供应商、端点与站内换算价格；最终扣费与分组倍率以 New API 控制台为准。

↗

集中管理

在控制台统一创建令牌、查看余额和调用记录，并根据业务需要切换模型，不必维护多套账号与配置。

一个入口，覆盖完整工作流。

从原型验证到线上应用，Recall API 将模型发现、密钥管理、请求转发与用量查看放在同一条路径里。你只需要选择模型、创建令牌，然后把请求发往统一接口。

API BASEnewapi.shallowrecall.top
PROTOCOLOpenAI Compatible
BILLING按站内倍率计费
CONSOLE令牌 · 余额 · 用量

开始使用。

先前往模型广场确认可用模型与价格，再进入控制台创建令牌。接口参数、SDK 用法和进阶配置可查阅 New API 文档。

STEP 01查看模型广场 →
STEP 02进入控制台 →
STEP 03阅读接口文档 →
STATUS查看模型供给 →

'').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (ch) => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }[ch])); const splitTags = (value) => String(value || '').split(',').map((item) => item.trim()).filter(Boolean); const modelPrice = (model) => { if (model.quota_type !== 0) return { input: Number(model.model_price || 0) * 7.3, output: 0, unit: '次' }; const ratio = Number(model.model_ratio || 0); const groupRatio = 1; const input = ratio * 2 * 7.3 * groupRatio; const output = input * Number(model.completion_ratio || 1); return { input, output, unit: '1M Tokens' }; }; const revealObserver = 'IntersectionObserver' in window ? new IntersectionObserver((entries) => { entries.forEach((entry) => { if (!entry.isIntersecting) return; entry.target.classList.add('is-visible'); revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target); }); }, { threshold: 0.12 }) : null; const observeReveals = (root = document) => { $$('.reveal', root).forEach((el) => { if (revealObserver) revealObserver.observe(el); else el.classList.add('is-visible'); }); }; const animateCounts = (root = document) => { $$('[data-count]', root).forEach((el) => { if (el.dataset.counted === '1') return; el.dataset.counted = '1'; const target = Number(el.dataset.count || 0); const suffix = el.dataset.suffix || ''; const start = performance.now(); const duration = 1100; const tick = (now) => { const p = Math.min(1, (now - start) / duration); const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3); el.textContent = Math.round(target * eased).toLocaleString('en-US') + suffix; if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick); }; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }); }; const showModal = (html) => { const modal = $('#modelModal'); if (!modal) return; $('#modelModalBody').innerHTML = html; modal.classList.add('is-open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }; const closeModal = () => { const modal = $('#modelModal'); if (!modal) return; modal.classList.remove('is-open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }; const openModel = (model, vendorName) => { const p = modelPrice(model); const tags = splitTags(model.tags); const endpoints = model.supported_endpoint_types || []; const groups = model.enable_groups || []; const icon = escapeHtml(vendorName.slice(0, 1)); showModal(`

${item.count} 个
`).join(''); const priced = models.map((model) => ({ model, p: modelPrice(model), vendor: vendorById.get(model.vendor_id) || '未知供应商' })).filter((item) => item.p.input > 0).sort((a,b) => a.p.input - b.p.input).slice(0, 7); const leaders = $('#priceLeaders'); if (leaders) leaders.innerHTML = priced.map(({ model, p, vendor }) => `
${escapeHtml(model.model_name)}${escapeHtml(vendor)} · 输入价格
${money(p.input)}
